The border shooting incident occurred on October 2, 2026, in Punjab's Tarn Taran district.

hindi_translation.headline: भारत ने घुसपैठ के मुद्दों पर पाकिस्तानी दूत को तलब किया, पंजाब सीमा पर बीएसएफ द्वारा 'नागरिकों की हत्या' के आरोपों को खारिज किया
hindi_translation.story_lead: भारत ने सीमा पार से होने वाली अवैध घुसपैठ के विरोध में पाकिस्तानी उच्च आयोग के चार्ज डी'एफेयर को तलब किया है। यह कूटनीतिक कदम पाकिस्तान द्वारा पंजाब सीमा पर बीएसएफ द्वारा दो लोगों की गोली मारकर हत्या किए जाने के विरोध में भारतीय दूत को तलब किए जाने के बाद उठाया गया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
भारत ने पाकिस्तान से सीमा पार अवैध घुसपैठ को लगातार बढ़ावा दिए जाने पर अपना कड़ा विरोध दर्ज कराने के लिए पाकिस्तानी उच्च आयोग के चार्ज डी'एफेयर को औपचारिक रूप से तलब किया। साथ ही, नई दिल्ली ने पाकिस्तान के उन आरोपों को खारिज कर दिया जिसमें कहा गया था कि 2 अक्टूबर 2026 को पंजाब सीमा पर भारतीय सुरक्षा कर्मियों ने दो 'निर्दोष नागरिकों' की हत्या कर दी है। विदेश मंत्रालय के अनुसार, तीन व्यक्तियों ने भारतीय क्षेत्र में घुसपैठ की थी और बीएसएफ द्वारा वापस लौटने की कई चेतावनियों के बावजूद सीमा बाड़ की ओर बढ़ना जारी रखा। आसन्न सुरक्षा खतरे को देखते हुए बीएसएफ को कार्रवाई करनी पड़ी। भारत ने पाकिस्तान से संचालित होने वाले सशस्त्र मादक पदार्थों के सिंडिकेट्स की स्पष्ट घुसपैठ की प्रवृत्ति पर प्रकाश डाला।

इससे पहले, पाकिस्तान ने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा के पास बेदियान सेक्टर में बीएसएफ कर्मियों द्वारा कथित रूप से दो पाकिस्तानी पुरुषों की हत्या के विरोध में भारतीय दूत को तलब किया था और दावा किया था कि वे निर्दोष नागरिक थे। पाकिस्तानी मीडिया और विदेश मंत्रालय के बयानों के अनुसार, इस घटना में कसूर जिले के लाधार गांव के तीन व्यक्ति शामिल थे, जिनकी पहचान अजमत रसूल और मोहसिन जुट्ट के रूप में हुई है, जिनमें से दो की मौत हो गई जबकि तीसरा घायल हो गया। पाकिस्तान ने इस घटना को मानवाधिकारों का उल्लंघन बताया और पारदर्शी जांच की मांग की।

भारतीय पक्ष के स्थानीय पुलिस और सुरक्षा विवरण एक अलग तस्वीर पेश करते हैं। तरनतारन के पुलिस उपअधीक्षक अतुल सोनी ने बताया कि तीन घुसपैठिए भारतीय सीमा की ओर बढ़ रहे थे, जिनमें से एक वापस पाकिस्तान लौट गया, जबकि अन्य दो ने चेतावनियों के बावजूद आगे बढ़ना जारी रखा। बीएसएफ के संतरी ने बताया कि दोनों व्यक्तियों ने सैनिकों को उकसाया और भारतीय क्षेत्र में प्रवेश करने की इच्छा व्यक्त की, जिसके बाद हुई गोलीबारी में दोनों मारे गए।
bullet_points: भारत ने सीमा पार घुसपैठ के विरोध में पाकिस्तानी दूत को तलब किया।
भारत ने बीएसएफ द्वारा नागरिकों की हत्या के पाकिस्तानी आरोपों को खारिज किया।
विदेश मंत्रालय ने कहा कि घुसपैठियों ने चेतावनियों की अनदेखी की।
भारत ने पाकिस्तान में सक्रिय नार्को-सिंडिकेट की भूमिका पर सवाल उठाया।
पाकिस्तान ने 2 अक्टूबर 2026 की घटना को लेकर भारतीय दूत को बुलाया था।

news.headline: Mumbai Police register FIR against 500 unnamed individuals and organisers over Cockroach Janta Party protest at Shivaji Park
news.story_lead: Mumbai Police have filed a first information report against the organisers and 400 to 500 unidentified individuals following a protest held by the Cockroach Janta Party at Shivaji Park. The demonstration took place despite police denying permission due to concerns surrounding noise pollution, traffic congestion, and vehicular disruptions.
news.full_article_text: Mumbai Police have registered an FIR against the organisers and a crowd of 400 to 500 unidentified persons in connection with a demonstration conducted by the Cockroach Janta Party at Shivaji Park. As law enforcement authorities continue their investigation, no arrests have been reported thus far. The case was initiated following a formal complaint lodged by a local resident and advocate, Siddhi Deolekar, at the Shivaji Park Police Station. The complaint specifically named party activists Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ratna Singh for assembling at the venue despite explicit police denial of permission. The charges invoked against the individuals include unlawful assembly, wilful disobedience of lawful orders promulgated by public servants, and related offences under sections 189 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), along with sections 37(1)(3) and 135 of the Maharashtra Police (MP) Act. The political outfit, spearheaded by founder Abhijeet Dipke, had organized the massive gathering on October 2 to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, pointing to alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Prior to the event, Mumbai Police had formally rejected permission for the assembly, citing public concerns over noise pollution, traffic congestion, and the smooth flow of vehicular traffic. In defiance of the refusal, Dipke had issued a call for a 'Jail Bharo Andolan', urging supporters to gather at the location.
bullet_points: Mumbai Police registered an FIR against the organisers and 400 to 500 unidentified individuals over a protest at Shivaji Park.
The demonstration was organised by the Cockroach Janta Party, led by founder Abhijeet Dipke, on October 2.
Protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls.
Police had explicitly denied permission for the gathering, citing concerns regarding noise pollution, traffic congestion, and vehicular disruption.
Following the denial, Abhijeet Dipke called for a 'Jail Bharo Andolan' and urged protesters to assemble at the venue.
The FIR was filed based on a complaint by resident and advocate Siddhi Deolekar at the Shivaji Park Police Station.
Named activists in the complaint include Abhijeet Dipke, Ashutosh Ranka, Saurav Das, and Ratna Singh.

The case has been registered under sections 189 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and sections 37(1)(3) and 135 of the Maharashtra Police (MP) Act for unlawful assembly and wilful disobedience of public servant orders.
key_facts: Police filed an FIR against 400-500 unidentified persons and organisers.
The protest occurred at Shivaji Park on October 2.

hindi_translation.story_lead: मुंबई पुलिस ने शिवाजी पार्क में आयोजित कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी के विरोध प्रदर्शन के सिलसिले में आयोजकों और 400 से 500 अज्ञात व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ प्राथमिकी दर्ज की है। यह प्रदर्शन ध्वनि प्रदूषण, यातायात जाम और आवाजाही में बाधा की चिंताओं के कारण पुलिस द्वारा अनुमति ठुकराए जाने के बावजूद किया गया था।

news.headline: Mumbai Police Files FIR Against Cockroach Janta Party Leaders and Supporters Over Unauthorized Shivaji Park Protest
news.story_lead: The Mumbai police have registered an FIR against leaders and over 400 supporters of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) for staging an illegal protest and sloganeering at Dadar's Shivaji Park on Gandhi Jayanti. Authorities had earlier denied permission for the gathering, citing a Bombay High Court ruling that restricts non-sporting activities at the historical ground.
news.full_article_text:
The Shivaji Park police station in Mumbai registered a case against several Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders and more than 400 of their supporters for holding an unlawful assembly and raising slogans in Dadar on October 2. The named accused include Abhijeet Dipke, Pranav Ahire, Ashutosh Ranka, Ajinkya Shinde, Saurabh Das, Afreen Nawaz, Saumya Korde, Ankit Bharadwaj, Vijay Malangi, and Yogesh Ingle. 

The FIR has been filed under sections 189 (unlawful assembly) and 223 (disobedience to a public servant’s lawful order) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, along with section 37 (power to prohibit certain acts for prevention of disorder) and section 135 (disobeying or breaking official orders issued by the police) of the Maharashtra Police Act.

Prior to the event, Mumbai police had denied permission to CJP representative Ajinkya Shinde for organizing the protest at Shivaji Park. Officials stated they lacked the authority to permit gatherings at the ground due to a Bombay High Court judgment in PIL 116/2009 dated January 4, 2013, and a subsequent Maharashtra government order dated January 20, 2016. Furthermore, police letters highlighted that the organisers failed to obtain required Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) permissions, and warned that protests in the residential and silence-zone area could cause severe traffic congestion and noise pollution, hindering access to nearby hospitals.

Despite being aware of the denial—which movement founder Abhijeet Dipke had acknowledged on social media—the CJP proceeded with a 'Jail Bharo Andolan' on Gandhi Jayanti. The protests were organized to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise and claims that he ignored or kept fellow election commissioners in the dark regarding certain decisions. Dipke also issued warnings of a potential 'Jantar Mantar 2.0' protest in Delhi on October 10.
news.background_context: The restriction on non-sporting activities at Shivaji Park stems from a Bombay High Court judgment in PIL 116/2009 dated January 4, 2013, which was reinforced by a Maharashtra government order dated January 20, 2016.
bullet_points: Mumbai police registered an FIR against CJP leaders and over 400 supporters for an illegal protest at Shivaji Park on October 2.
The case was filed under sections 189 and 223 of BNS, 2023, and sections 37 and 135 of the Maharashtra Police Act.
Police denied permission citing a 2013 Bombay High Court order and a 2016 Maharashtra government order restricting Shivaji Park to sports.
Authorities also cited lack of BMC permission, potential noise pollution, traffic congestion, and proximity to hospitals.

Over 400 supporters were booked alongside the CJP leaders.
The protest took place on October 2, 2026 (Gandhi Jayanti).

news.upsc_analysis: The incident brings to focus the operational interplay between freedom of assembly (Article 19) and reasonable restrictions imposed by statutory laws, police orders, and judicial rulings protecting public spaces and civic amenities.

news.mains_notes: The police action against the unauthorized protest at Shivaji Park underscores the binding nature of judicial directives on public ground usage, such as the 2013 Bombay High Court ruling. hindi_translation.headline: मुंबई पुलिस ने शिवाजी पार्क प्रदर्शन को लेकर सीजेपी नेताओं और समर्थकों के खिलाफ एफआईआर दर्ज की
hindi_translation.story_lead: मुंबई पुलिस ने गांधी जयंती के अवसर पर दादर के शिवाजी पार्क में अवैध रूप से एकत्र होने और नारेबाजी करने को लेकर कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (सीजेपी) के नेताओं और 400 से अधिक समर्थकों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया है। अधिकारियों ने ऐतिहासिक मैदान पर गैर-खेल गतिविधियों को प्रतिबंधित करने वाले बंबई उच्च न्यायालय के फैसले का हवाला देते हुए इस सभा की अनुमति पहले ही अस्वीकार कर दी थी।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
मुंबई के शिवाजी पार्क पुलिस स्टेशन ने 2 अक्टूबर को दादर में गैरकानूनी रूप से इकट्ठा होने और नारे लगाने के लिए कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (सीजेपी) के नेताओं और 400 से अधिक समर्थकों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया है। नामित आरोपियों में अभिजीत दिपके, प्रणव आहिर, आशुतोष रांका, अजिंक्य शिंदे, सौरभ दास, आफरीन नवाज, सौम्या कोर्डे, अंकित भारद्वाज, विजय मलंगी और योगेश इंगले शामिल हैं।

यह मामला भारतीय न्याय संहिता, 2023 की धारा 189 (गैरकानूनी जमावड़ा) और 223 (लोक सेवक के वैध आदेश की अवज्ञा), तथा महाराष्ट्र पुलिस अधिनियम की धारा 37 (व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के लिए कुछ कृत्यों को प्रतिबंधित करने की शक्ति) और 135 के तहत दर्ज किया गया है।

घटना से पहले, मुंबई पुलिस ने शिवाजी पार्क में विरोध प्रदर्शन आयोजित करने के लिए सीजेपी प्रतिनिधि अजिंक्य शिंदे की अनुमति को यह कहते हुए अस्वीकार कर दिया था कि वे पीआईएल 116/2009 में बंबई उच्च न्यायालय के 4 जनवरी 2013 के फैसले और 20 जनवरी 2016 के महाराष्ट्र सरकार के आदेश के मद्देनजर किसी भी सभा के लिए अनुमति देने के लिए अधिकृत नहीं हैं। पुलिस ने यह भी बताया कि आयोजकों ने बीएमसी की अनुमति प्राप्त नहीं की थी, और चेतावनी दी थी कि आवासीय एवं शांत क्षेत्र में होने वाले प्रदर्शन से ध्वनि प्रदूषण और गंभीर ट्रैफिक जाम हो सकता है।

news.headline: Gurugram Man Dies by Suicide from Noida High-Rise After Financial Distress
news.story_lead: A 29-year-old man from Manesar, Gurugram, died by suicide after jumping from the 41st floor of a high-rise building in Noida Sector 94. Preliminary police investigations indicate that financial distress and refusal to return home despite his father's urging led to the tragic incident.
news.full_article_text: A 29-year-old resident of Manesar, Gurugram, died by suicide after jumping from the 41st floor of the Supernova Spira society in Noida Sector 94. The incident occurred on Saturday around 11 am when the man crossed his Airbnb balcony and began walking along the ledge. An AC technician working on an adjacent balcony attempted to intervene and stop him, but the man jumped before the technician and his colleagues could reach him. According to local police, the victim had left his home three days prior to the incident and stayed at various hotels before checking into the Airbnb on Friday at approximately 3 pm. Investigators examining his mobile phone discovered chat logs between the deceased and his father, which revealed ongoing monetary troubles. The father had repeatedly urged his son to return home, but the young man refused. Sector 126 station house officer Sumnesh Kumar confirmed that the chats are part of the ongoing probe. Police have sent the body for an autopsy, informed the family, reviewed CCTV footage from the building and surrounding areas, and questioned individuals present near the scene.
bullet_points: A 29-year-old man from Manesar, Gurugram, died by suicide by jumping from the 41st floor of a Noida high-rise.
The incident took place on Saturday around 11 am at the Supernova Spira society located in Noida Sector 94.

Preliminary investigations and chat logs indicate that the man was suffering from severe financial strain.
His father had been urging him to return home through chat messages, but he refused.
Local police have sent the body for an autopsy, informed the family, examined CCTV footage, and are questioning witnesses.

hindi_translation.story_lead: गुरुग्राम के मानेसर के रहने वाले 29 वर्षीय एक युवक ने नोएडा सेक्टर 94 स्थित सुपरनोवा स्पाइरा सोसाइटी की 41वीं मंजिल से कूदकर आत्महत्या कर ली। शुरुआती जांच से पता चला है कि वह आर्थिक तंगी से परेशान था।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: गुरुग्राम के मानेसर के रहने वाले 29 वर्षीय व्यक्ति ने नोएडा सेक्टर 94 स्थित सुपरनोवा स्पाइरा सोसाइटी की 41वीं मंजिल से कूदकर आत्महत्या कर ली। यह घटना शनिवार को सुबह करीब 11 बजे हुई जब युवक ने एयरबीएनबी की बालकनी पार कर छज्जे पर चलना शुरू कर दिया। बगल की बालकनी में काम कर रहे एक एसी तकनीशियन ने उसे रोकने की कोशिश की, लेकिन इससे पहले कि वह और उसके सहकर्मी हस्तक्षेप करते, युवक नीचे कूद चुका था। पुलिस के अनुसार, मृतक ने घटना से तीन दिन पहले अपना घर छोड़ दिया था और विभिन्न होटलों में रुकने के बाद शुक्रवार दोपहर करीब 3 बजे एयरबीएनबी में चेक-इन किया था। पुलिस ने मृतक के मोबाइल फोन से उसके पिता के साथ हुई बातचीत की चैट को भी खंगाला है, जिससे वित्तीय संकट का पता चलता है। पिता उसे लगातार घर लौटने का आग्रह कर रहे थे, लेकिन उसने मना कर दिया था। सेक्टर 126 के थाना प्रभारी (एसएचओ) सुमनेश कुमार ने बताया कि मामले की जांच की जा रही है। पुलिस ने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेजकर परिजनों को सूचित कर दिया है और आसपास के सीसीटीवी फुटेज की जांच कर रही है।

यह घटना शनिवार को सुबह करीब 11 बजे नोएडा सेक्टर 94 की सुपरनोवा स्पाइरा सोसाइटी में हुई।

पड़ोस की बालकनी में काम कर रहे एक एसी तकनीशियन ने उसे बचाने का प्रयास किया था।
चैट से पता चला कि मृतक वित्तीय समस्याओं से जूझ रहा था और पिता के बार-बार कहने के बावजूद घर नहीं लौट रहा था।

news.headline: Telangana Police Arrest Seven, Including Three Serving Army Personnel, in Major Arms Theft Case
news.story_lead: Telangana Police have arrested seven additional individuals, including three serving Army personnel, following the theft of sophisticated firearms and ammunition from the 20 Battalion of the Madras Regiment in Secunderabad Cantonment. Investigators revealed that the stolen weapons were intended for major property offenses such as bank and jewelry store robberies, with no extremist or terrorist links found.
news.full_article_text:
Telangana Police arrested seven individuals, including three active-duty Army personnel, in connection with a major arms theft from the 20 Battalion of the Madras Regiment at Bollaram in the Secunderabad Cantonment. The incident came to light on August 31 when battalion personnel discovered that the locks of the arms store (Kote) and Magazine had been broken. Lieutenant Colonel Mayank Govitirkar, the battalion commanding officer, filed a formal complaint at the Bollaram police station the same evening regarding missing sophisticated weapons and ammunition.

According to Malkajgiri Police Commissioner B. Sumathi, the prime accused—identified as retired havildar Upputholla Mallesh (37)—was previously arrested on September 11. Police subsequently secured a 10-day custody of Mallesh from September 22 to October 1, during which the broader conspiracy was uncovered. Mallesh allegedly plotted the heist with his cousin Upputholla Mallikarjun (37) and friend Chemmakar Niranjan (39) due to financial difficulties. They planned to use the stolen firearms to rob banks, jewelry shops, and wealthy individuals.

Investigations revealed that Mallesh approached Avi Dey alias Obi and Birbal Shaw in West Bengal to sell the stolen hardware. Obi allegedly agreed to purchase pistols for ₹3 lakh each and long weapons for ₹5 lakh each, alongside ammunition. Mallesh enlisted three former colleagues from the Madras Regiment—sepoy Konduri Sheshulu (36), jawan Vinod Kumar (34), and havildar Kucharakanthi Praveen (37)—to break the armory locks. Along with Obi (32) and Shaw (27), all seven suspects were arrested on a Saturday and presented before a local court, which remanded them to judicial custody for 14 days.

The stolen inventory included four AK-203 rifles with five magazines, one INSAS rifle with three magazines, six 9mm pistols with 12 magazines, one 6.35-bore civilian pistol with a magazine, three binoculars, 1,156 rounds of 9mm ammunition, 720 rounds of AK-203 ammunition, and 36 INSAS rounds. Police recovered the hidden weapons at Mallesh's father's residence in Achampet. Authorities also uncovered a 2022 connection where Mallesh had previously acquired a country-made firearm from the West Bengal contacts while posted in Barrackpore.
news.background_context: The prime accused, Upputholla Mallesh, was previously posted at Barrackpore, Kolkata, in 2022, where he established contact with Birbal Shaw and Avi Dey alias Obi, leading to an earlier acquisition of a country-made firearm.

news.headline: Haryana NCR petrol pumps mandated to check PUC certificates before refuelling starting October 1
news.story_lead: Petrol pumps across Haryana's National Capital Region (NCR) districts have been instructed to verify Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates before dispensing fuel, adhering to a directive issued by the state transport department. Vehicles lacking a valid certificate will be denied fuel under broader air pollution mitigation measures. The rule applies to petrol, diesel, and CNG stations alike.
news.full_article_text:
Petrol pumps situated in Haryana's National Capital Region (NCR) districts are required to verify Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates prior to refuelling vehicles, following a directive issued by the Haryana transport department. The measure is part of the Centre's air pollution control initiatives and implements direction number 101 from the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM). The policy mandates that petrol, diesel, and CNG stations ensure vehicles possess a valid PUC before fuel is dispensed.

According to an order issued by Atul Kumar, Commissioner and Secretary of Transport, to state co-ordinators of Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Bharat Petroleum, and Hindustan Petroleum, fuel stations are instructed to use Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras to match vehicle registration numbers with the online PUC database. Until these ANPR systems are fully installed and operational across all NCR districts, pump operators must deploy staff to manually verify vehicle PUC documents before refuelling.

If a vehicle owner fails to produce a valid PUC certificate, fuel stations must refuse service and log the vehicle's registration number for official records. Furthermore, vehicles found without valid certification are directed to the nearest authorised PUC testing centre to secure the necessary clearance before they can obtain fuel. Operating a vehicle without a valid PUC certificate can attract fines up to ₹10,000 under the Motor Vehicle Rules.

To ensure motorist awareness, the transport department has instructed fuel station operators to install prominent bilingual warning signs in both English and Hindi at all fuel dispensing points. Operators have been directed to implement these procedures immediately and submit an action taken report within three days, with warnings of strict punitive action for any laxity in enforcement.
news.background_context: The directive implements direction number 101 of the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) as part of the Centre's air pollution control measures in the National Capital Region.

news.headline: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha calls India’s truce proposal the most comprehensive
news.story_lead: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha announced that Kyiv has received ceasefire proposals from four countries, highlighting India's initiative as the most comprehensive. Sybiha stated that Ukraine is open to various truce formats, provided they encompass security guarantees for energy infrastructure, port facilities, and the Black Sea.
news.full_article_text:
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha stated in Kyiv that Ukraine has received truce and ceasefire proposals from four nations: India, Turkey, Egypt, and the United States. According to Sybiha, the proposal put forward by India is the most comprehensive among them. Ukraine is willing to evaluate different ceasefire structures—including an unconditional truce along the front-line contact zones—provided the agreement comprehensively covers the cessation of attacks on energy facilities, port infrastructure, and operations in the Black Sea.

Elaborating on the other proposals, Sybiha noted that Turkey and Egypt previously advanced initiatives aimed at establishing a Black Sea truce to restore Ukrainian grain exports. Meanwhile, the US proposal focuses specifically on an energy truce between Ukraine and Russia, which was discussed during a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Sybiha added that a broader truce could emerge as an outcome of direct talks between Zelenskyy and Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Indian officials have maintained regular contact with both Moscow and Kyiv, emphasizing New Delhi's readiness to help conclude the war, which India highlights has severely affected global food, fuel, and fertilizer security, particularly across the Global South. Russian President Vladimir Putin acknowledged Prime Minister Narendra Modi's persistent diplomatic efforts during the Valdai Discussion Club annual meeting in Moscow, noting that Modi consistently raises the conflict and offers constructive ideas while maintaining a neutral position. High-level diplomatic engagements have included Prime Minister Modi meeting Putin on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit in Kyrgyzstan in August, ahead of the BRICS Summit in New Delhi last month, and meeting Zelenskyy at the G7 Summit in France in June. Additionally, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar visited Kyiv in early September to reiterate India's stance that the conflict cannot be resolved on the battlefield.
bullet_points: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha stated that Ukraine has received ceasefire proposals from four countries: India, Turkey, Egypt, and the US.
Sybiha described India's proposal as the 'most comprehensive' among the options received.
Turkey and Egypt previously proposed a Black Sea truce aimed at restoring grain exports from Ukraine.
The US proposal centers on an energy truce and was discussed between President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and President Donald Trump.
Ukraine is ready to consider different ceasefire formats, including an unconditional truce along the front lines, if it includes energy and port security and the Black Sea.
Russian President Vladimir Putin commended PM Narendra Modi's consistent engagement and neutral stance toward finding a peaceful resolution.
External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar visited Kyiv in early September to emphasize that the conflict cannot be resolved on the battlefield.
key_facts: Ukraine has received ceasefire proposals from four countries: India, Turkey, Egypt, and the US.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha termed India's proposal the most comprehensive.
Turkey and Egypt's proposal focused on a Black Sea truce for grain exports.
The US proposal focuses on an energy truce discussed by Zelenskyy and Trump.

Relevant for international relations, India's foreign policy, and multilateral engagements (SCO, BRICS, G7).
news.upsc_analysis: India's consistent advocacy for dialogue and a peaceful resolution in the Russia-Ukraine conflict reflects its strategic autonomy and growing diplomatic stature. By maintaining open channels with both Moscow and Kyiv, India positions itself as a credible interlocutor capable of addressing broader global concerns such as food, fuel, and fertilizer security for the Global South.
causes: The ongoing Russia-Ukraine war impacting global food, fuel, and fertilizer security, particularly for the Global South.
impacts: Disruption of global food and energy supplies, leading diplomatic actors to propose localized and comprehensive ceasefires.
challenges: Reconciling differing ceasefire terms and conditions between Russia and Ukraine regarding energy infrastructure, port security, and front-line boundaries.

way_forward: Continue active diplomatic engagement with both warring parties and multilateral forums to support a negotiated, peaceful settlement.
news.mains_notes: India's diplomatic approach to the Russia-Ukraine conflict underscores its commitment to strategic autonomy and peaceful resolution. While maintaining strong ties with Russia, New Delhi has consistently engaged Ukraine and offered comprehensive perspectives addressing energy, port security, and food security. This positions India as an important bridge-builder in contemporary geopolitics.

hindi_translation.headline: यूक्रेनी विदेश मंत्री आंद्रेई सिबीहा ने यूक्रेन के लिए भारतीय संघर्षविराम प्रस्ताव को 'सबसे व्यापक' बताया
hindi_translation.story_lead: यूक्रेनी विदेश मंत्री आंद्रेई सिबीहा ने घोषणा की है कि कीव को चार देशों से संघर्षविराम के प्रस्ताव मिले हैं, जिनमें भारत के प्रस्ताव को सबसे व्यापक बताया गया है। सिबीहा ने कहा कि यूक्रेन विभिन्न युद्धविराम विकल्पों के लिए तैयार है, बशर्ते इसमें ऊर्जा और बंदरगाह के बुनियादी ढांचे तथा काला सागर की सुरक्षा शामिल हो।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: यूक्रेनी विदेश मंत्री आंद्रेई सिबीहा ने कीव में संवाददाताओं से कहा कि यूक्रेन को भारत, तुर्की, मिस्र और अमेरिका से युद्धविराम के प्रस्ताव मिले हैं। सिबीहा के अनुसार, इनमें भारत का प्रस्ताव सबसे व्यापक है। यूक्रेन ऊर्जा और बंदरगाह बुनियादी ढांचे तथा काला सागर की स्थिति पर हमलों को रोकने वाले समझौते के संयोजन के साथ विभिन्न युद्धविराम प्रारूपों पर विचार करने के लिए तैयार है। अन्य प्रस्तावों में तुर्की और मिस्र द्वारा काला सागर में अनाज के निर्यात को बहाल करने के लिए दिए गए सुझाव शामिल हैं, जबकि अमेरिकी प्रस्ताव यूक्रेन और रूस के बीच ऊर्जा युद्धविराम पर जोर देता है। भारतीय पक्ष ने लगातार इस बात पर जोर दिया है कि वह रूस और युद्धरत पक्षों के संपर्क में है और वैश्विक दक्षिण के लिए खाद्य, ईंधन और उर्वरक सुरक्षा को प्रभावित करने वाले इस युद्ध को समाप्त करने में सहायता करने के लिए तैयार है। रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन ने भी प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के कूटनीतिक प्रयासों की सराहना की है।

news.headline: IAF Chief A P Singh Addresses Pakistan-China Fifth-Generation Jet Collaboration and Modernisation Challenges
news.story_lead: Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal A P Singh acknowledged that Pakistan's reported collaboration with China on fifth-generation fighter jets is a cause for concern for India, but affirmed that the Indian Air Force possesses the capabilities to counter the threat. Speaking ahead of Air Force Day, Singh emphasised the urgency of accelerating indigenous jet programmes like the AMCA and finalising ongoing acquisition deals.
news.full_article_text:
Chief of Air Staff Air Chief Marshal A P Singh stated during an annual press conference ahead of Air Force Day that Pakistan's reported collaboration with China regarding fifth-generation fighter jets presents a concern for India. However, he clarified that the Indian Air Force (IAF) maintains the necessary capabilities to handle the challenge for the time being. According to reports, Pakistan may acquire these aircraft soon, with pilots allegedly undergoing training in China. Singh stressed that aircraft effectiveness depends not only on the platform itself but also on how well it is integrated into overall military capabilities, noting that Pakistan failed to achieve significant results with past platforms during Operation Sindoor. 

To maintain its tactical edge, India must push forward with the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme and avoid delays, or else explore alternative decisions. The IAF chief also highlighted that the force requires the induction of at least 36 to 40 fighter aircraft annually over the coming years to stem the decline in squadron strength. On major procurement initiatives, India intends to finalise the multi-role fighter aircraft (MRFA) deal within the current financial year. In February, the government cleared a proposal to procure 114 Rafale fighter jets from France under a government-to-government framework, and price negotiations are currently ongoing. Additionally, Singh disclosed that Russia has offered its Su-57 fighter jets to India, though no decision has been reached regarding this offer. Finally, the Air Chief underscored the necessity of integrating artificial intelligence to create an AI-augmented force and emphasised domestic manufacturing and self-reliance, particularly in developing a local fighter jet engine.
bullet_points: IAF Chief Air Chief Marshal A P Singh stated that Pakistan and China's collaboration on fifth-generation fighter jets is a concern for India.
Reports indicate Pakistan may acquire fifth-generation jets soon, with pilots allegedly training in China.
Singh emphasized that overall system integration matters more than the platform alone, citing Pakistan's performance during Operation Sindoor.
India needs to accelerate the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme and avoid delays.
The IAF needs to induct 36 to 40 aircraft every year over the next few years to address declining squadron strength.
India is looking to finalise the multi-role fighter aircraft (MRFA) deal for 114 Rafale jets from France within the current financial year.
Russia has officially offered its Su-57 fighter jets to India, though no final decision has been made.
The Air Chief stressed the importance of building an AI-augmented force and achieving self-reliance in developing a domestic fighter jet engine.
key_facts: Air Chief Marshal A P Singh is the Chief of Air Staff.
The government cleared a proposal in February to procure 114 Rafale fighter jets from France.
Russia has offered its Su-57 fighter jets to India.
The IAF needs to induct 36 to 40 aircraft annually over the coming years.

exam_relevance: Relevant for UPSC Mains General Studies Paper III (Security, Defence preparedness, and Indigenisation of technology).
news.upsc_analysis: The statement by the IAF Chief underscores the dual challenge of managing regional security dynamics, such as advanced military technology acquisitions by adversaries, while simultaneously addressing indigenous manufacturing delays and squadron strength depletion in India's defence framework.
causes: Regional military collaboration between Pakistan and China regarding fifth-generation fighter jets.
impacts: Declining strength of IAF fighter squadrons necessitating the induction of 36 to 40 aircraft annually.
Urgency in accelerating indigenous projects like the AMCA and expediting procurement deals like the MRFA.
challenges: Potential delays in the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme.
Maintaining force levels and combat readiness amidst declining squadron numbers.
government_steps: Cleared a long-pending proposal in February to procure 114 Rafale fighter jets from France under a government-to-government framework.
Pushing forward with the Advanced Medium Combat Aircraft (AMCA) programme and exploring domestic engine manufacturing.
way_forward: Accelerate indigenous defence manufacturing capabilities, particularly in aero-engine technology, and expedite critical procurement deals to maintain strategic air superiority.
news.mains_notes: The IAF Chief's remarks highlight India's strategic imperatives: balancing immediate procurement needs (such as the MRFA Rafale deal and evaluating the Russian Su-57 offer) with long-term indigenization goals through the AMCA programme. Self-reliance in defence manufacturing, integration of artificial intelligence, and maintaining adequate squadron strength are vital for countering regional security threats.

news.takeaway: While Pakistan and China's fifth-generation fighter jet collaboration poses a concern, the IAF maintains the capability to counter it, emphasizing domestic manufacturing, AI integration, and swift acquisitions.

hindi_translation.story_lead: वायु सेना प्रमुख एयर चीफ मार्शल एपी सिंह ने स्वीकार किया कि पाकिस्तान और चीन के बीच पांचवीं पीढ़ी के लड़ाकू विमानों को लेकर कथित सहयोग भारत के लिए चिंता का विषय है, लेकिन उन्होंने जोड़ा कि भारतीय वायु सेना के पास इस खतरे से निपटने की क्षमता है।

news.headline: Odisha rape accused injured in police encounter in Chandaka during escape attempt
news.story_lead: A man accused of raping a 26-year-old woman at gunpoint in Nayapalli was injured in a police encounter in Chandaka after opening fire on law enforcement officers. The accused, identified as Sridhar Panda, sustained bullet injuries to his foot and was admitted to Capital Hospital in Bhubaneswar for treatment.
news.full_article_text:
An individual accused of committing a rape at gunpoint against a 26-year-old woman in Odisha’s Nayapalli was injured during a police encounter in Chandaka on Saturday. According to Bhubaneswar deputy commissioner of police Saravana Dr Vivek M Saravana, the suspect, Sridhar Panda from Ganjam district, sustained two bullet injuries to his left foot when police returned fire in self-defence after he opened two rounds of gunfire while attempting to evade arrest.

The incident follows a first information report (FIR) lodged by the victim on Thursday at the Nayapalli police station. The survivor reported that an unidentified masked man entered her rented accommodation in Behera Sahi on Wednesday evening while she was alone, threatened her with what appeared to be a gun, and allegedly assaulted her. Investigators later noted that the suspect used a lighter styled to resemble a firearm, tied the victim with her scarf, and smashed her mobile phone before fleeing.

Police investigations revealed that Panda had prior involvement in two mobile theft cases and had initially monitored the house for theft before his motive allegedly changed upon finding the victim alone. Surveillance footage captured the suspect walking towards CRP Square, boarding an Ama Bus, and subsequently stealing a motorcycle to escape. A scientific team visited the crime site to collect evidence.

Meanwhile, the Odisha State Commission for Women took suo motu cognisance of the assault on Friday, directing the Bhubaneswar DCP to furnish a report within 15 days. Police confirmed that Panda is currently receiving treatment at Capital Hospital in Bhubaneswar and will be formally placed under arrest upon his recovery.
bullet_points: A 26-year-old woman filed an FIR at Nayapalli police station alleging she was raped at gunpoint in her rented house.
The incident occurred on Wednesday evening in the Behera Sahi area when the victim was alone.
The accused used a lighter styled like a gun, tied the victim with her scarf, and smashed her mobile phone.
Sridhar Panda, a resident of Ganjam district, was identified as the prime suspect with prior mobile theft cases.
Panda was traced to Chandaka on Saturday, where he allegedly fired two rounds at police while attempting to escape.
Police fired in self-defence, injuring Panda's left foot with two bullet wounds.
The suspect was admitted to Capital Hospital in Bhubaneswar for medical treatment and will be formally arrested after recovery.
The Odisha State Commission for Women took suo motu cognisance and ordered the Bhubaneswar DCP to submit a report within 15 days.

Location of crime: Behera Sahi, Nayapalli, Bhubaneswar
Encounter location: Chandaka
Hospital: Capital Hospital, Bhubaneswar
Investigating official: Bhubaneswar DCP Saravana Dr Vivek M Saravana

The suspect attempted to flee during apprehension and fired at police personnel, leading to retaliatory firing.

government_steps: Nayapalli police station registered an FIR and deployed scientific teams for evidence collection.
Police tracked the suspect to Chandaka and conducted an operation to apprehend him.

The suspect, Sridhar Panda, was later injured in a police encounter in Chandaka after opening fire during an escape attempt. The Odisha State Commission for Women intervened by taking suo motu cognisance and demanding a report within 15 days, highlighting mechanisms of institutional accountability and law enforcement response.

hindi_translation.headline: ओडिशा में पुलिस मुठभेड़ में बलात्कार का आरोपी गोली लगने से घायल
hindi_translation.story_lead: नयापल्ली में बंदूक की नोक पर 26 वर्षीय महिला के साथ बलात्कार के आरोपी को चांडका में पुलिस मुठभेड़ के दौरान गोली लग गई। आरोपी ने पुलिस दल पर गोली चलाई थी, जिसके बाद जवाबी कार्रवाई में उसे पैर में चोट आई और उसे भुवनेश्वर के कैपिटल अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
ओडिशा के नयापल्ली में एक महिला के साथ कथित बलात्कार के मामले में वांछित आरोपी शनिवार को चांडका में पुलिस मुठभेड़ के दौरान घायल हो गया। भुवनेश्वर के पुलिस उपायुक्त (DCP) सारावना डॉ. विवेक एम सारावना के अनुसार, गंजम जिले के रहने वाले आरोपी श्रीधर पांडा ने गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए पुलिस दल पर दो राउंड गोलियां चलाईं, जिसके बाद आत्मरक्षा में की गई पुलिस की जवाबी कार्रवाई में उसके बाएं पैर में दो गोलियां लग गईं।

यह घटना गुरुवार को नयापल्ली पुलिस स्टेशन में पीड़िता द्वारा दर्ज कराई गई प्राथमिकी (FIR) के बाद सामने आई। पीड़िता ने अपनी शिकायत में बताया कि बुधवार शाम जब वह अपने किराए के मकान में अकेली थी, तब एक अज्ञात नकाबपोश व्यक्ति ने घर में प्रवेश किया, उसे बंदूक से डराया और कथित तौर पर बलात्कार किया। पुलिस जांच में पता चला कि आरोपी ने पिस्तौल जैसी दिखने वाली लाइटर का इस्तेमाल किया था, पीड़िता को उसके दुपट्टे से बांध दिया था और उसका मोबाइल फोन तोड़ दिया था।

पुलिस के मुताबिक, आरोपी के खिलाफ पहले से मोबाइल चोरी के दो मामले दर्ज थे और उसने चोरी के इरादे से घर की रेकी की थी, लेकिन महिला को अकेला पाकर उसका इरादा बदल गया। सीसीटीवी फुटेज से पता चला कि आरोपी ने सीआरपी स्क्वायर की ओर पैदल यात्रा की, एक अमा बस पकड़ी और बाद में एक मोटरसाइकिल चुराकर भाग निकला। वैज्ञानिक टीम ने मौके पर पहुंचकर नमूने एकत्र किए।

इस बीच, ओडिशा राज्य महिला आयोग ने शुक्रवार को इस मामले का स्वतः संज्ञान लिया और भुवनेश्वर के डीसीपी को 15 दिन के भीतर रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने का निर्देश दिया। पुलिस ने बताया कि आरोपी का कैपिटल अस्पताल में इलाज चल रहा है और स्वस्थ होने के बाद उसे औपचारिक रूप से गिरफ्तार किया जाएगा।
bullet_points: पीड़िता ने नयापल्ली पुलिस स्टेशन में प्राथमिकी दर्ज कराई जिसमें बंदूक की नोक पर बलात्कार का आरोप लगाया गया।
यह घटना बुधवार शाम को बेहेरा साही इलाके में हुई जब पीड़िता घर पर अकेली थी।
आरोपी ने बंदूक जैसे दिखने वाले लाइटर का उपयोग किया, पीड़िता को दुपट्टे से बांधा और उसका मोबाइल फोन तोड़ दिया।
गंजम जिले के श्रीधर पांडा की पहचान मुख्य संदिग्ध के रूप में हुई जिसके खिलाफ चोरी के पुराने मामले दर्ज थे।
शनिवार को चांडका में पुलिस ने पांडा को ट्रेस किया, जहां उसने भागने की कोशिश में पुलिस पर गोली चलाई।
पुलिस ने आत्मरक्षा में गोली चलाई जिससे आरोपी के बाएं पैर में चोट लगी।
आरोपी को भुवनेश्वर के कैपिटल अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया और स्वस्थ होने के बाद औपचारिक गिरफ्तारी होगी।
ओडिशा राज्य महिला आयोग ने स्वतः संज्ञान लेते हुए 15 दिनों में रिपोर्ट तलब की है।
key_facts: आरोपी: गंजम जिले का श्रीधर पांडा
पीड़िता: 26 वर्षीय महिला
घटना स्थल: नयापल्ली, भुवनेश्वर
मुठभेड़ स्थल: चांडका
अस्पताल: कैपिटल अस्पताल, भुवनेश्वर
important_dates: बुधवार: घर में प्रवेश और कथित अपराध
गुरुवार: नयापल्ली थाने में प्राथमिकी दर्ज
शुक्रवार: राज्य महिला आयोग द्वारा स्वतः संज्ञान और 15 दिन में रिपोर्ट का निर्देश

news.headline: Haryana-NCR Fuel Stations Mandated to Deny Petrol and Diesel to Vehicles Lacking Valid PUC
news.story_lead: Fuel stations across Haryana's National Capital Region districts have been instructed to verify Pollution Under Control certificates before dispensing petrol, diesel, or CNG. The measure follows the Commission for Air Quality Management's direction to curb vehicular emissions in the region.
news.full_article_text:
Petrol, diesel, and CNG stations located within the Haryana districts of the National Capital Region (NCR) are required to verify valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) certificates prior to refuelling vehicles. Enforced under the Centre's air pollution control initiatives, the directive stems from Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) direction number 101. 

At the operational level, fuel stations are directed to utilize Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras to cross-check vehicle registration numbers against the online PUC database. Until these camera systems are fully operational across all NCR districts, pump operators must manually check the PUC status of vehicles before dispensing fuel. If motorists cannot produce a valid certificate, fuel stations must refuse supply and log the vehicle's registration number for official records. Furthermore, operators are mandated to display prominent bilingual signs in Hindi and English at dispensing points to inform drivers.

Vehicles operating without a valid PUC can attract fines of up to ₹10,000 under the Motor Vehicle Rules, and drivers are to be directed to the nearest authorized PUC testing centre. Fuel pumps were ordered to implement these measures immediately and submit an action taken report within three days, with warnings of strict punitive action for any laxity.
bullet_points: Fuel stations in Haryana-NCR must deny petrol, diesel, and CNG to vehicles without a valid PUC certificate.
The directive is based on the Commission for Air Quality Management's (CAQM) direction number 101.
Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras will eventually match vehicle numbers with online PUC databases.
Until ANPR systems are fully installed, fuel pump staff must manually verify PUC certificates.
Vehicles unable to produce a valid certificate will be refused fuel, and their registration numbers will be recorded.
Operating a vehicle without a valid PUC can invite fines up to ₹10,000 under Motor Vehicle Rules.
Non-compliant vehicles will be directed to the nearest authorized PUC testing centre.
Petrol pumps must display prominent bilingual warning signs in English and Hindi at dispensing points.
Operators were instructed to implement the rules immediately and submit an action taken report within three days.
key_facts: The 'no PUC, no fuel' rule applies to petrol, diesel, and CNG stations in Haryana-NCR districts.
The policy is enforced pursuant to CAQM direction number 101.
Fines for driving without a valid PUC can reach up to ₹10,000 under Motor Vehicle Rules.
Fuel stations are required to submit an action taken report within three days.

October 30: Date of the Haryana transport department directive issued by Atul Kumar
exam_relevance: Useful for understanding measures implemented by statutory bodies like the Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) to tackle urban air pollution in the National Capital Region.
news.upsc_analysis: The directive highlights the administrative enforcement mechanisms used by state transport authorities and environmental commissions to curb vehicular pollution in the National Capital Region by leveraging digital infrastructure like ANPR cameras and strict retail-level compliance.
causes: High levels of air pollution in the National Capital Region necessitating stricter vehicular emission controls.
impacts: Stricter monitoring of vehicular emissions at retail fuel outlets across Haryana-NCR districts.
Denial of fuel service to non-compliant vehicle owners lacking valid PUC certificates.
challenges: Manual verification by petrol pump staff until Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) systems are fully installed and operational across all NCR districts.

Installation of Automated Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras at petrol pumps.

Motor Vehicle Rules

news.mains_notes: Haryana's transport department has implemented the Commission for Air Quality Management's (CAQM) 'no PUC, no fuel' policy across NCR districts. Fuel stations are required to verify PUC certificates using ANPR cameras or manual checks, refusing fuel to non-compliant vehicles and recording registration numbers. Violations under Motor Vehicle Rules can attract fines up to ₹10,000, reflecting a shift towards stricter retail-level enforcement of environmental standards.

hindi_translation.headline: हरियाणा-एनसीआर के पेट्रोल पंपों पर वैध पीयूसी के बिना वाहनों को ईंधन नहीं दिया जाएगा
hindi_translation.story_lead: हरियाणा के राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र के जिलों में ईंधन स्टेशनों को निर्देश दिया गया है कि वे वाहनों में पेट्रोल, डीजल या सीएनजी भरने से पहले प्रदूषण नियंत्रण (पीयूसी) प्रमाण पत्र की जांच करें। यह कदम वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग के निर्देशों के तहत उठाया गया है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
हरियाणा के राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र (एनसीआर) के जिलों में स्थित पेट्रोल, डीजल और सीएनजी स्टेशनों को वाहनों में ईंधन भरने से पहले वैध प्रदूषण नियंत्रण (पीयूसी) प्रमाण पत्र सत्यापित करना होगा। केंद्र के वायु प्रदूषण नियंत्रण उपायों के तहत लागू यह निर्देश वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग (सीएक्यूएम) के निर्देश संख्या 101 से उपजा है।

संचालन स्तर पर, ईंधन स्टेशनों को ऑनलाइन पीयूसी डेटाबेस के साथ वाहन पंजीकरण नंबरों का मिलान करने के लिए स्वचालित नंबर प्लेट पहचान (एएनपीआर) कैमरों का उपयोग करने का निर्देश दिया गया है। जब तक ये कैमरा सिस्टम सभी एनसीआर जिलों में पूरी तरह से चालू नहीं हो जाते, तब तक पंप संचालकों को ईंधन भरने से पहले वाहनों के पीयूसी की मैन्युअल रूप से जांच करने का निर्देश दिया गया है। यदि वाहन मालिक वैध प्रमाण पत्र प्रस्तुत करने में असमर्थ है, तो पेट्रोल पंप को ईंधन देने से मना करना होगा और आधिकारिक उद्देश्यों के लिए वाहन का पंजीकरण नंबर दर्ज करना होगा। इसके अलावा, संचालकों को वितरण बिंदुओं पर अंग्रेजी और हिंदी में प्रमुख द्विभाषी चेतावनी बोर्ड प्रदर्शित करने का निर्देश दिया गया है।

वैध पीयूसी के बिना वाहन चलाने पर मोटर वाहन नियमों के तहत ₹10,000 तक का जुर्माना लग सकता है, और बिना वैध प्रमाण पत्र वाले वाहनों को ईंधन भरवाने से पहले निकटतम अधिकृत पीयूसी परीक्षण केंद्र पर जाने का निर्देश दिया जाता है। ईंधन पंपों को इन उपायों को तुरंत लागू करने और तीन दिनों के भीतर कार्रवाई रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने का आदेश दिया गया है।
bullet_points: हरियाणा-एनसीआर में पेट्रोल, डीजल और सीएनजी स्टेशनों को वैध पीयूसी के बिना वाहनों को ईंधन देने से मना करना होगा।
यह निर्देश वायु गुणवत्ता प्रबंधन आयोग (सीएक्यूएम) के निर्देश संख्या 101 पर आधारित है।
स्वचालित नंबर प्लेट पहचान (एएनपीआर) कैमरे वाहन नंबरों का ऑनलाइन पीयूसी डेटाबेस से मिलान करेंगे।
एएनपीआर प्रणालियों के स्थापित होने तक, ईंधन पंप कर्मचारियों को मैन्युअल रूप से पीयूसी की जांच करनी होगी।
वैध प्रमाण पत्र न दिखाने वाले वाहनों को ईंधन देने से इनकार किया जाएगा और उनके पंजीकरण नंबर दर्ज किए जाएंगे।
वैध पीयूसी के बिना वाहन चलाने पर मोटर वाहन नियमों के तहत ₹10,000 तक का जुर्माना लग सकता है।
बिना प्रमाण पत्र वाले वाहनों को निकटतम अधिकृत पीयूसी परीक्षण केंद्र भेजा जाएगा।
पेट्रोल पंपों पर अंग्रेजी और हिंदी में प्रमुख द्विभाषी संकेत लगाना अनिवार्य किया गया है।
संचालकों को तीन दिन के भीतर कार्रवाई रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करने का निर्देश दिया गया है।
key_facts: हरियाणा-एनसीआर के पेट्रोल, डीजल और सीएनजी स्टेशनों पर 'नो पीयूसी, नो फ्यूल' नियम लागू किया गया है।
यह नीति सीएक्यूएम के निर्देश संख्या 101 के तहत लागू की गई है।
वैध पीयूसी के बिना गाड़ी चलाने पर मोटर वाहन नियमों के तहत ₹10,000 तक का जुर्माना हो सकता है।

news.headline: Punjabi Makeup Artist and Influencer Mad Sandhu Shot Dead in Amritsar
news.story_lead: Punjabi social media influencer and makeup artist Mad Sandhu was shot dead by two unidentified men on a motorcycle in Amritsar. Sandhu, whose full first name was Madhusudan, succumbed to his injuries while being transported to a hospital.
news.full_article_text:
Punjabi influencer and makeup artist Mad Sandhu was fatally shot by two unidentified men on a motorcycle in Amritsar on a Saturday evening around 6 pm. He was found lying on the road in a pool of blood after sustaining a gunshot wound, and a video of the incident subsequently circulated widely on social media. According to PTI reports citing Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Sirivennela, Sandhu passed away while he was being rushed to the hospital, and local police have arrived at the scene to launch an investigation.

Mad Sandhu, whose full first name was Madhusudan, was well-known for appearing as a guest on various podcasts to discuss makeup, the film industry, and gender issues. Openly identifying as a gay man, he often faced homophobic trolling on social media, to which he publicly responded that God had made him the way he was. Professionally, Sandhu began his career in the fashion industry working as a stylist and assistant costume designer for films across Punjab and Mumbai. He later gained widespread popularity through Instagram reels and viral videos where he shared beauty and luxury fashion tips, lifestyle content, and his candid views on pop culture, social norms, and LGBTQ+ acceptance. He also made appearances in several Punjabi films, including the 'Oye Bhole Oye' series.
bullet_points: Mad Sandhu, whose full first name was Madhusudan, was shot dead in Amritsar by two motorcycle-borne assailants.
The shooting occurred around 6 pm, and police confirmed he died while being taken to the hospital.
Sandhu was a prominent Punjabi makeup artist, stylist, and social media influencer with a large following on Instagram.
He was openly gay and frequently addressed LGBTQ+ acceptance, social norms, and gender issues on podcasts and social media.
He worked behind the scenes as a stylist and assistant costume designer in the Punjab and Mumbai film industries.
He acted in several Punjabi films, notably including the 'Oye Bhole Oye' series.
Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police Sirivennela confirmed that police have launched an active investigation into the shooting.
key_facts: Victim: Mad Sandhu (Madhusudan)
Incident location: Amritsar, Punjab
Time of attack: Around 6 pm on Saturday
Assailants: Two unidentified men on a motorcycle
Profession: Makeup artist, stylist, social media influencer, and actor
Film credits: Appeared in the 'Oye Bhole Oye' series
important_dates: Saturday - Date of the shooting incident in Amritsar

news.upsc_analysis: The tragic incident highlights the growing vulnerabilities faced by independent digital influencers and public figures, particularly those belonging to marginalized or non-conforming communities who confront online harassment and offline safety challenges.

hindi_translation.headline: पंजाब के मेकअप आर्टिस्ट और इनफ्लुएंसर Mad Sandhu की अमृतसर में गोली मारकर हत्या
hindi_translation.story_lead: पंजाब के सोशल मीडिया इनफ्लुएंसर और मेकअप आर्टिस्ट Mad Sandhu की अमृतसर में मोटरसाइकिल सवार दो अज्ञात लोगों ने गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी। अस्पताल ले जाते समय रास्ते में उनकी मृत्यु हो गई।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
पंजाब के इनफ्लुएंसर और मेकअप आर्टिस्ट Mad Sandhu की शनिवार शाम को अमृतसर में दो मोटरसाइकिल सवार बदमाशों ने गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी। गोली लगने के बाद वह सड़क पर खून से लथपथ पाए गए और इस घटना का एक वीडियो सोशल मीडिया पर वायरल हो गया। पीटीआई की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, एडिशनल डिप्टी कमिश्नर ऑफ पुलिस सिरिवेननेला ने बताया कि अस्पताल ले जाते समय उनका निधन हो गया। पुलिस ने मौके पर पहुंचकर मामले की जांच शुरू कर दी है।

मधुसूदन नाम से पहचाने जाने वाले Mad Sandhu मेकअप, फिल्म उद्योग और लैंगिक मुद्दों पर चर्चा करने के लिए अक्सर पॉडकास्ट में गेस्ट के रूप में दिखाई देते थे। एक समलैंगिक व्यक्ति के रूप में अपनी पहचान को लेकर वह खुले थे और उन्हें अक्सर सोशल मीडिया पर समलैंगिक-विरोधी ट्रोलिंग का सामना करना पड़ता था। उन्होंने आलोचकों को जवाब देते हुए कहा था कि भगवान ने उन्हें जैसा बनाया है, वह वैसे ही हैं। अपने पेशेवर करियर की शुरुआत फैशन इंडस्ट्री में स्टाइलिस्ट और सहायक कॉस्ट्यूम डिजाइनर के रूप में करने वाले Sandhu ने पंजाब और मुंबई की फिल्मों में काम किया। बाद में उन्होंने इंस्टाग्राम रील्स और वायरल वीडियो के माध्यम से व्यापक लोकप्रियता हासिल की, जहां उन्होंने लग्जरी फैशन, ब्यूटी टिप्स, लाइफस्टाइल कंटेंट और सामाजिक मानदंडों पर अपनी बेबाक राय साझा की। उन्होंने 'ओये भोले ओये' सीरीज सहित कई पंजाबी फिल्मों में भी अभिनय किया था।
bullet_points: पंजाब के मेकअप आर्टिस्ट और इनफ्लुएंसर Mad Sandhu की अमृतसर में गोली मारकर हत्या कर दी गई।
यह घटना शनिवार शाम करीब 6 बजे हुई और पुलिस के अनुसार अस्पताल ले जाते समय उनकी मृत्यु हो गई।
Sandhu एक खुले तौर पर समलैंगिक व्यक्ति थे और अक्सर LGBTQ+ स्वीकृति तथा सामाजिक मुद्दों पर अपनी बात रखते थे।
उन्होंने पंजाब और मुंबई की फिल्मों में स्टाइलिस्ट और सहायक कॉस्ट्यूम डिजाइनर के रूप में काम किया था।
उन्होंने 'ओये भोले ओये' जैसी पंजाबी फिल्मों में भी अभिनय किया था।

news.headline: India Slams Pakistan at UN Over Jammu & Kashmir Remarks, Calls Islamabad's Civilian Leadership Subservient to Army
news.story_lead: Exercising its Right of Reply at the United Nations, India strongly rebuffed Pakistan's reference to Jammu and Kashmir during a UN General Assembly committee meeting. India stated that the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh are integral parts of the country and accused Islamabad's civilian administration of operating at the mercy of its military establishment.
news.full_article_text:
India exercised its Right of Reply in response to remarks made by Pakistan regarding Jammu and Kashmir at the UN General Assembly Third Committee meeting. Categorically rejecting the assertions, India's representative Bhavika Mangalanandan, First Secretary at the Permanent Mission of India to the UN, reiterated that the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh were, are, and will always remain integral and inalienable parts of India.

During the session, India highlighted the political reality in Pakistan, asserting that civilian governments in Islamabad serve at the mercy of their Army and rarely complete their political terms. The statement also pointed to the continued imprisonment of former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan amidst reports of rapidly deteriorating health.

India accused Pakistan of attempting to deflect attention from domestic discontent and instability by fomenting unrest and sponsoring cross-border terrorism in India for over three decades. Furthermore, India described Pakistan's comments on Jammu and Kashmir as a desperate diversionary tactic designed to mask tragedies and civilian killings in Rawalakot and other cities across Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir (PoJK). It attributed these incidents to protests over basic necessities like bread, electricity, and human dignity, stemming from prolonged military occupation and the suppression of free media.

Contrasting the situation with Pakistan's political landscape—which India referenced using the term 'Form 47' to denote allegations of electoral rigging in the 2024 general elections—India emphasized that Jammu and Kashmir successfully conducted Assembly Elections in 2024 with massive voter turnout, resulting in a peaceful transfer of power to a democratically elected government. India concluded that the sole outstanding issue regarding Jammu and Kashmir is the vacation of territories under Pakistan's illegal and forcible occupation, while urging Islamabad to focus on internal stability and economic development instead of territorial ambitions.
bullet_points: India exercised its Right of Reply at the UN General Assembly Third Committee meeting addressing social, humanitarian, and cultural issues.
India asserted that the Union Territories of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh remain integral and inalienable parts of the country.
Bhavika Mangalanandan stated that civilian governments in Pakistan operate at the mercy of their Army and rarely finish their terms.
India raised concerns regarding the continued detention of former Pakistan prime minister Imran Khan and his deteriorating health.
Pakistan was accused of using Kashmir rhetoric to mask domestic turmoil, crackdowns, and civilian killings in Rawalakot and PoJK.
India highlighted the 2024 J&K Assembly Elections, noting high voter turnout and a peaceful transfer of power to an elected government.
The term 'Form 47' was referenced to highlight allegations of rigging in Pakistan's 2024 general elections.
India maintained that the only pending issue is Pakistan vacating the territories under its illegal and forcible occupation.
key_facts: Forum: UN General Assembly Third Committee meeting.
Indian Representative: Bhavika Mangalanandan (First Secretary at India's Permanent Mission to the UN).
Key regions affirmed: Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.
Electoral contrast: J&K held assembly elections in 2024 with a massive turnout, unlike Pakistan's disputed 'Form 47' general elections.
important_dates: 2024: Pakistan general elections and Jammu & Kashmir Assembly Elections
exam_relevance: Relevant for understanding India's diplomatic stance on cross-border terrorism and territorial sovereignty at international forums like the United Nations.
Provides context on bilateral diplomatic exchanges between India and Pakistan.
news.upsc_analysis: India's robust diplomatic response at the UN General Assembly underscores its consistent policy of countering Pakistan's narrative on Jammu and Kashmir while highlighting democratic credentials through domestic electoral participation. The statement effectively shifts international focus toward internal governance issues, human rights concerns in Pakistan-occupied territories, and the dominance of the military establishment in Islamabad.
causes: Pakistan's diplomatic remarks regarding Jammu and Kashmir at the United Nations.
impacts: Reiteration of India's principled stance on sovereignty over Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh at a global multilateral platform.
challenges: Persistent cross-border terrorism and diplomatic propaganda from Pakistan regarding Jammu and Kashmir.
government_steps: Exercising the Right of Reply at the UN General Assembly to counter Pakistan's allegations and highlight regional democratic processes.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Article 1 and Schedule I of the Constitution of India regarding Union Territories.
way_forward: Continued diplomatic engagement to expose state-sponsored cross-border terrorism and reaffirm India's democratic consolidation in Jammu & Kashmir.
news.mains_notes: India used the UN General Assembly Third Committee platform to dismiss Pakistan's remarks on Jammu and Kashmir. India stressed that J&K and Ladakh are integral parts of the nation, highlighted the democratic transition via the 2024 J&K Assembly elections, and called out Islamabad's military dominance, human rights crackdowns in PoJK, and support for cross-border terrorism.
mains_questions: Analyze India's diplomatic strategy at multilateral forums in countering false narratives regarding Jammu and Kashmir.
Discuss the implications of political instability and military dominance in Pakistan on bilateral relations in South Asia.
news.takeaway: India strongly countered Pakistan's remarks at the UN, asserting sovereignty over Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh while highlighting Islamabad's internal governance crises and military control.
prelims_facts: UN General Assembly Third Committee deals with social, humanitarian, and cultural issues.
Jammu and Kashmir held assembly elections in 2024.

hindi_translation.headline: संयुक्त राष्ट्र में जम्मू-कश्मीर की टिप्पणी पर भारत का पाकिस्तान को करारा जवाब, कहा- 'वहां की तथाकथित सरकारें सेना की दया पर निर्भर'
hindi_translation.story_lead: संयुक्त राष्ट्र में पाकिस्तान द्वारा जम्मू-कश्मीर का मुद्दा उठाए जाने पर भारत ने अपने 'राइट ऑफ रिप्लाई' का उपयोग करते हुए तीखी प्रतिक्रिया दी। भारत ने स्पष्ट किया कि केंद्र शासित प्रदेश जम्मू-कश्मीर और लद्दाख हमेशा से भारत के अभिन्न अंग रहे हैं और आगे भी रहेंगे, साथ ही इस्लामाबाद की नागरिक सरकारों पर सेना के नियंत्रण का मुद्दा उठाया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा की तीसरी समिति की बैठक में जम्मू-कश्मीर पर पाकिस्तान की टिप्पणियों का कड़ा जवाब दिया। संयुक्त राष्ट्र में भारत के स्थायी मिशन की प्रथम सचिव भाविका मंगलांदन ने स्पष्ट रूप से इन टिप्पणियों को खारिज करते हुए दोहराया कि जम्मू-कश्मीर और लद्दाख भारत के अभिन्न और अविभाज्य अंग हैं।

बैठक के दौरान भारत ने पाकिस्तान की राजनीतिक व्यवस्था पर कटाक्ष करते हुए कहा कि वहां की तथाकथित नागरिक सरकारें सेना की दया पर चलती हैं और शायद ही कभी अपना कार्यकाल पूरा कर पाती हैं। भारत ने पाकिस्तान के पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री इमरान खान की लगातार जेल में कैद और उनकी खराब होती सेहत का भी जिक्र किया।

भारत ने पाकिस्तान पर घरेलू असंतोष से ध्यान भटकाने के लिए भारत में अस्थिरता फैलाने और तीन दशकों से अधिक समय से सीमा पार आतंकवाद को बढ़ावा देने का आरोप लगाया। इसके अलावा, भारत ने कहा कि पाकिस्तान के ये बयान रावलकोट और पाकिस्तान के कब्जे वाले जम्मू-कश्मीर (PoJK) के अन्य शहरों में नागरिकों की हत्याओं और बर्बर कार्रवाई से ध्यान भटकाने के desesperate प्रयास हैं, जहां जनता रोटी, बिजली और मानवाधिकारों की मांग कर रही है।

पाकिस्तान में स्वतंत्र मीडिया पर प्रतिबंध और 2024 के आम चुनावों में कथित धांधली ('फॉर्म 47' सरकार) का जिक्र करते हुए भारत ने कहा कि इसके विपरीत जम्मू-कश्मीर में 2024 में भारी मतदान के साथ विधानसभा चुनाव हुए और एक निर्वाचित सरकार को शांतिपूर्ण सत्ता हस्तांतरण हुआ। भारत ने जोर देकर कहा कि पाकिस्तान द्वारा अवैध रूप से कब्जाए गए क्षेत्रों को खाली कराना ही एकमात्र शेष मुद्दा है।
bullet_points: भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा की तीसरी समिति की बैठक में 'राइट ऑफ रिप्लाई' का उपयोग किया।
भारत ने दोहराया कि जम्मू-कश्मीर और लद्दाख भारत के अभिन्न अंग हैं।
भारत ने रेखांकित किया कि पाकिस्तान में नागरिक सरकारें सेना के नियंत्रण में काम करती हैं।
पाकिस्तान के कब्जे वाले जम्मू-कश्मीर और रावलकोट में जनता के दमन का मुद्दा उठाया गया।
भारत ने 2024 के जम्मू-कश्मीर विधानसभा चुनावों और शांतिपूर्ण सत्ता हस्तांतरण का हवाला दिया।
key_facts: मंच: संयुक्त राष्ट्र महासभा तीसरी समिति
भारतीय प्रतिनिधि: भाविका मंगलांदन
क्षेत्र: जम्मू-कश्मीर और लद्दाख

news.headline: Actor Prakash Raj criticises CEC and SIR process, demands its scrapping amid protests in Telangana
news.story_lead: Actor and activist Prakash Raj has strongly criticised Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, demanding its immediate scrapping. His remarks sparked a sharp reaction from the BJP, while various organisations held protests in Telangana calling for the CEC's resignation and the repeal of the CEC Act 2023.
news.full_article_text:
Actor and activist Prakash Raj made controversial remarks during a public interaction, stating that while the immersion of Ganesha idols for Ganesh Chaturthi was over in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, and across India, the 'visarjan' (immersion) of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar remains. Criticising the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, Raj alleged that what was initially framed as an electoral cleanup exercise has effectively become a deletion drive rather than an inclusive one.

Highlighting specific concerns during a 10-day tour of various districts to meet citizens, Raj claimed that numerous names were deleted from electoral rolls simply because individuals were not at home when Booth Level Officers (BLO) visited. He also pointed out that daily wage workers who migrated elsewhere for employment have been removed from the voters' list. Furthermore, he cited media reports indicating that 38 lakh voter appeals for inclusion—concerning individuals removed from rolls—are currently pending before tribunals in West Bengal, with estimates suggesting it could take 10 to 12 years to resolve them, raising questions on whether applicants should wait that long.

In response to these remarks, Telangana BJP chief spokesperson N V Subhash strongly condemned Raj's statements, calling them insulting and crossing the line from political criticism into disrespect of a constitutional institution. Subhash asserted that democracy requires constructive debate rather than derision and suggested that objections to the SIR process should be presented with facts and evidence before appropriate forums rather than through provocative street rhetoric.

Concurrently, a protest demonstration was organised in the region by groups including the Telangana People's Front and Cockroach Janta Party, demanding the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, the scrapping of the SIR exercise, and the repeal of the CEC Act 2023. Protesters carried posters with slogans such as "Gyanesh, It's Done Bro!", "Gyanesh Kumar Must Resign", and "Save Democracy."
bullet_points: Actor Prakash Raj criticised the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) electoral process, calling for its scrapping during a public address.
He claimed that the SIR process functions as a deletion exercise rather than an inclusive cleanup, impacting daily wage workers and residents who were absent during BLO visits.
Raj highlighted that 38 lakh voter appeals against removals are pending before tribunals in West Bengal, potentially taking 10-12 years to resolve.
Telangana BJP chief spokesperson N V Subhash condemned Raj's remarks, stating that comparing the CEC to idol immersion disrespects a constitutional institution.
Protests were organised in Telangana by groups like Telangana People's Front and Cockroach Janta Party demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation and the repeal of the CEC Act 2023.
key_facts: Prakash Raj alleged that names are deleted from voter rolls if citizens are not home during Booth Level Officer visits.
38 lakh voter inclusion appeals are reportedly pending before tribunals in West Bengal.
Organizations protesting in Telangana demanded the scrapping of the SIR exercise and repeal of the CEC Act 2023.
important_dates: Saturday (Protests and statements made)
exam_relevance: Relevant for UPSC Civil Services Prelims regarding the Election Commission of India and voter list revision processes.
Relevant for UPSC Mains (Polity) concerning the independence, credibility, and criticism of constitutional bodies in India.
news.upsc_analysis: The public debate and protests surrounding the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls highlight the delicate balance between administrative electoral cleanup and citizens' right to franchise. Criticism directed at the Chief Election Commission underscores discussions on institutional autonomy, accountability, and the grievance redressal mechanisms for electoral roll omissions.
causes: Removal of voter names during Booth Level Officer house visits when residents were temporarily away for work.

impacts: Public protests and demonstrations in Telangana demanding the CEC's resignation.

challenges: Delays in addressing pending voter inclusion appeals before tribunals, estimated to take over a decade in states like West Bengal.

way_forward: Ensuring transparent and inclusive verification processes during electoral roll revisions to prevent wrongful deletion of eligible voters.
news.mains_notes: The controversy surrounding the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls brings to light systemic challenges in electoral management, such as voter disenfranchisement due to temporary migration and backlogs in tribunal appeals. While criticism of administrative bodies is a part of democratic discourse, maintaining institutional respect for constitutional authorities like the Election Commission is vital for democratic stability.

Examine the role and independence of the Election Commission of India in maintaining the integrity of electoral rolls.
news.takeaway: Actor Prakash Raj's criticism of the CEC and the SIR electoral revision process has sparked political debate and protests in Telangana regarding voter roll deletions and institutional accountability.

hindi_translation.headline: गणेश विसर्जन खत्म, ज्ञानेश कुमार विसर्जन बाकी: प्रकाश राज
hindi_translation.story_lead: अभिनेता और कार्यकर्ता प्रकाश राज ने मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार और विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) प्रक्रिया की कड़ी आलोचना करते हुए इसे तत्काल रद्द करने की मांग की है। उनके इस बयान पर भाजपा की तीखी प्रतिक्रिया आई है, जबकि तेलंगाना में विभिन्न संगठनों ने चुनाव आयुक्त के इस्तीफे और CEC अधिनियम 2023 को रद्द करने की मांग को लेकर प्रदर्शन किए।
hindi_translation.full_article_text: अभिनेता और कार्यकर्ता प्रकाश राज ने एक सार्वजनिक कार्यक्रम के दौरान टिप्पणी की कि कर्नाटक, आंध्र प्रदेश और पूरे भारत में गणेश विसर्जन समाप्त हो चुका है, लेकिन मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार का 'विसर्जन' अभी बाकी है। विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) प्रक्रिया की आलोचना करते हुए उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि मतदाता सूची सुधारने की प्रक्रिया असल में नाम हटाने का अभियान बन गई है। विभिन्न जिलों के 10-दिवसीय दौरे के दौरान उन्होंने दावा किया कि बूथ लेवल ऑफिसर (BLO) के घर आने के समय लोगों के मौजूद न होने के कारण उनके नाम मतदाता सूची से हटा दिए गए। उन्होंने यह भी कहा कि काम के सिलसिले में बाहर गए दैनिक वेतन भोगी मजदूरों के नाम भी सूची से हटाए गए हैं। इसके अलावा, उन्होंने पश्चिम बंगाल के Tribunals में मतदाताओं की सूची में नाम शामिल कराने के लिए लंबित 38 लाख अपीलों का हवाला देते हुए कहा कि इनके निपटारे में 10 से 12 साल लग सकते हैं। इस बयान पर तेलंगाना भाजपा के मुख्य प्रवक्ता एन.वी. सुभाष ने कड़ी आपत्ति जताई और इसे संवैधानिक संस्था का अनादर बताया। इस बीच, तेलंगाना पीपुल्स फ्रंट और कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी सहित विभिन्न संगठनों ने CEC के इस्तीफे और SIR प्रक्रिया को समाप्त करने की मांग को लेकर प्रदर्शन किया।
bullet_points: अभिनेता प्रकाश राज ने विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) चुनावी प्रक्रिया की आलोचना करते हुए इसे रद्द करने की मांग की।
उन्होंने आरोप लगाया कि SIR प्रक्रिया मतदाताओं को शामिल करने के बजाय नाम हटाने का जरिया बन गई है।
पश्चिम बंगाल में मतदाता सूची में नाम जुड़वाने से जुड़ी 38 लाख अपीलें लंबित हैं।
तेलंगाना भाजपा ने प्रकाश राज की टिप्पणी को संवैधानिक संस्था का अपमान बताया।
तेलंगाना में कई संगठनों ने CEC ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर विरोध प्रदर्शन किया।
key_facts: प्रकाश राज ने SIR प्रक्रिया को रद्द करने की मांग उठाई।
पश्चिम बंगाल ट्रिब्यूनल में 38 लाख मतदाता अपीलें लंबित हैं।
तेलंगाना में CEC के इस्तीफे की मांग को लेकर विरोध प्रदर्शन हुए।

news.headline: TVK Chief Vijay Condemns DMK Leader Stalin's Remarks on Dharapuram Candidate P Sathyabama
news.story_lead: Tamil Nadu chief minister and TVK leader C Joseph Vijay strongly condemned DMK president MK Stalin for allegedly making indecent and body-shaming remarks about TVK's Dharapuram bypoll candidate P Sathyabama. The controversy erupted ahead of the October 6 bypoll, with TVK announcing plans to approach the Election Commission.
news.full_article_text: Tamil Nadu chief minister and TVK leader C Joseph Vijay has strongly denounced DMK president MK Stalin over alleged derogatory remarks directed at TVK candidate P Sathyabama during an election campaign meeting in Dharapuram. Vijay accused Stalin of mocking the physical appearance and speaking with utmost indecency about Sathyabama, labeling the DMK as a force of evil whose members are enemies of democracy. The remarks in question were made by Stalin while campaigning for DMK candidate S Suganya, during which he referred to Sathyabama as 'Petti Bama' and 'Palti Bama' after she switched from the AIADMK to the TVK. TVK leaders, including CTR Nirmal Kumar, criticized the comments as body-shaming directed at a Scheduled Caste woman participating in electoral politics, and announced that the party would approach the Election Commission. Nirmal Kumar also demanded a public apology from Stalin and denied allegations of money distribution by the TVK. The Dharapuram by-election was necessitated after P Sathyabama resigned from her former position as an AIADMK MLA to join the TVK and contest the bypoll. Other candidates in the fray include S Suganya for the DMK and K Bhanumathi for the AIADMK.

news.headline: Elderly couple seriously injured in Kirti Nagar hit-and-run incident; female driver arrested
news.story_lead: An elderly couple in west Delhi's Kirti Nagar was struck from behind by a Hyundai Creta while returning from a morning walk, sustaining serious injuries. The driver initially stopped and approached the victims before fleeing the scene, but was subsequently traced, arrested, and her vehicle impounded by the police.
news.full_article_text:
A 79-year-old footwear sole manufacturer, Dayanand Tangra, and his 71-year-old homemaker wife, Kusum Tangra, were severely injured after being hit by a car from behind on Friday. The incident took place near Arya Samaj Mandir at approximately 9.30 am as the couple was walking back to their residence in Kirti Nagar after completing their morning walk. CCTV footage captured a Hyundai Creta taking a left turn onto their road, suddenly veering left, and striking the couple with enough impact to hurl them into the air. The elderly woman landed near an electric pole, while her husband was thrown several feet away.

The footage showed the driver, identified as 49-year-old homemaker Navleen Kaur, stepping out of her vehicle and checking on the injured man. However, after lingering around for roughly 30 seconds, she drove away from the spot without rendering timely assistance or taking them to a hospital. The injured couple was later admitted to a private facility for treatment, where Dayanand Tangra was noted to have sustained a serious head injury and his wife suffered injuries to the rear part of her body.

According to Deputy Commissioner of Police (West) Hareshwar V Swami, law enforcement registered a case under section 281 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) pertaining to rash driving and acts endangering life or personal safety at the Kirti Nagar police station. The accused driver was arrested, and the offending vehicle was impounded. The couple resides in Kirti Nagar, while their two daughters live in the United States with their families.
bullet_points: The hit-and-run incident occurred on Friday around 9.30 am near Arya Samaj Mandir in west Delhi's Kirti Nagar.

Dayanand Tangra suffered a serious head injury, while his wife sustained injuries to the rear portion of her body.
A case was registered under section 281 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) at the Kirti Nagar police station.
The police arrested the accused driver and impounded the offending vehicle, with the victims admitted to a private hospital for treatment.

hindi_translation.headline: दिल्ली के कीर्ति नगर में कार की टक्कर से बुजुर्ग दंपति हवा में उछले, घायल; महिला ड्राइवर फरार
hindi_translation.story_lead: पश्चिमी दिल्ली के कीर्ति नगर इलाके में मॉर्निंग वॉक से लौट रहे एक बुजुर्ग दंपति को पीछे से एक कार ने टक्कर मार दी, जिससे वे गंभीर रूप से घायल हो गए। महिला ड्राइवर ने शुरुआत में वाहन रोककर मदद की कोशिश का नाटक किया और बाद में मौके से फरार हो गई, जिसे पुलिस ने बाद में गिरफ्तार कर लिया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
शुक्रवार सुबह मॉर्निंग वॉक से घर लौट रहे 79 वर्षीय फुटवियर सोल निर्माता दयानंद टंगरा और उनकी 71 वर्षीय पत्नी कुसुम टंगरा को पीछे से आ रही एक कार ने जोरदार टक्कर मार दी। यह दुर्घटना कीर्ति नगर के आर्य समाज मंदिर के पास सुबह करीब 9:30 बजे हुई। सीसीटीवी फुटेज में एक हुंडई क्रेटा कार को बाएं मुड़ते और अचानक सड़क की बाईं तरफ मुड़कर दंपति को टक्कर मारते हुए देखा गया। टक्कर इतनी जोरदार थी कि दोनों हवा में उछल गए। बुजुर्ग महिला एक बिजली के खंबे के पास गिरीं जबकि उनके पति को कुछ दूर फेंका गया।

फुटेज के अनुसार, 49 वर्षीय महिला ड्राइवर नवलीन कौर ने गाड़ी रोकी, नीचे उतरी और घायल व्यक्ति के पास गईं। हालांकि, करीब 30 सेकंड तक मौके पर रुकने के बाद वह बिना घायल दंपति को अस्पताल ले जाए अपनी कार से फरार हो गई। पुलिस ने घायलों को एक निजी अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया, जहां दयानंद टंगरा को सिर में गंभीर चोटें आईं और उनकी पत्नी के शरीर के पिछले हिस्से में चोटें लगीं।

पश्चिमी जिले के पुलिस उपायुक्त (डीसीपी) हरेश्वर वी स्वामी ने बताया कि कीर्ति नगर पुलिस स्टेशन में भारतीय न्याय संहिता (बीएनएस) की धारा 281 के तहत लापरवाही से गाड़ी चलाने और जीवन को खतरे में डालने का मामला दर्ज किया गया है। आरोपी महिला ड्राइवर को गिरफ्तार कर लिया गया है और उसकी गाड़ी को ज़ब्त कर लिया गया है।
bullet_points: यह हिट-एंड-रन दुर्घटना शुक्रवार को सुबह करीब 9:30 बजे पश्चिमी दिल्ली के कीर्ति नगर में आर्य समाज मंदिर के पास हुई।
पीड़ित दयानंद टंगरा (79) और कुसुम टंगरा (71) मॉर्निंग वॉक से लौट रहे थे जब उन्हें पीछे से हुंडई क्रेटा ने टक्कर मारी।
सीसीटीवी फुटेज में टक्कर के कारण दोनों के हवा में उछलने और महिला के खंभे के पास गिरने की पुष्टि हुई।
महिला ड्राइवर नवलीन कौर (49) ने घायल बुजुर्ग के पास जाने के बाद 30 सेकंड में मौके से फरार होना चुना।
दयानंद टंगरा को सिर में गंभीर चोट आई, जबकि उनकी पत्नी को शरीर के पिछले हिस्से में चोटें लगीं।
कीर्ति नगर पुलिस स्टेशन में भारतीय न्याय संहिता (बीएनएस) की धारा 281 के तहत मामला दर्ज किया गया है।
पुलिस ने आरोपी महिला ड्राइवर को गिरफ्तार कर वाहन को ज़ब्त कर लिया है और घायलों का इलाज निजी अस्पताल में जारी है।
key_facts: पीड़ित: दयानंद टंगरा (79) और कुसुम टंगरा (71)
आरोपी ड्राइवर: नवलीन कौर, उम्र 49 वर्ष

news.headline: Prashant Bhushan, Neha Bora and 160 Detained on Second Day of Anti-CEC Protest in New Delhi
news.story_lead: Delhi Police detained 160 protesters, including prominent lawyers, activists, and student leaders, on the second consecutive day of demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The agitation, which faced prohibitory orders and heavy barricading, prompted calls for a fresh citizen's march.
news.full_article_text:
The agitation demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar entered its second consecutive day in New Delhi, resulting in the detention of 160 protesters by the Delhi Police on Saturday. Those taken into custody included senior Supreme Court advocate Prashant Bhushan, political activist Yogendra Yadav, All India Students' Association (AISA) national president Neha Bora, and RTI activist Anjali Bhardwaj. Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal also joined to back the stir.

The demonstration followed a massive crackdown a day earlier in which over 1,000 protesters were detained. On Saturday, student activists and citizens gathered near Ashoka Road and Vithal Bhai Patel House around 1 pm, following a call issued by AISA. Security arrangements were heavy, with multiple layers of barricades, sealed routes, and hundreds of security personnel deployed across the area. The march began with a two-hour delay around 3 pm led by prominent figures, but police moved swiftly to disperse the gathering and detained individuals within 15 minutes of commencement.

Authorities stated that no prior intimation or permission had been granted for any protest on October 3. Furthermore, prohibitory orders under Section 163 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023, remained enforced across the New Delhi district to maintain public order, ensure public safety, and facilitate traffic movement. Those detained, including Bhushan, Yadav, and Bhardwaj, were transported to different police stations, such as the Badarpur Police Station.

Following the police action, Yogendra Yadav denounced the measures as police brutality and announced a fresh citizen's march scheduled for Sunday, October 4, starting from India Gate and moving toward Jantar Mantar. Meanwhile, legal figures like Prashant Bhushan condemned the detentions, stating that state repression cannot silence public expression.
bullet_points: Delhi Police detained 160 protesters on the second day of anti-CEC demonstrations on Saturday.
